patches.name: Disable Expo updates
patches.description: Forces the app to use bundled local assets instead of Expo OTA updates.

patches.name: Pin local Expo config
patches.description: Disables Expo update URL/config values in assets/app.config.

patches.name: Disable ad SDK manifest components
patches.description: Removes or disables ad SDK manifest components and ad identifier permissions where safe.

patches.name: Neutralize bundled ad unit IDs
patches.description: Neutralizes bundled AdMob ad unit IDs while leaving the real AdMob app ID intact.

patches.name: Neutralize premium and reward-ad prompts
patches.description: Blanks known premium, rewarded-ad, and ad prompt strings in the Hermes bundle.

patches.name: Disable ad and promo remote config
patches.description: Blackholes bundled ad, reward, paywall, and premium-banner remote config keys.

patches.name: Hermes hide ad promo surfaces
patches.description: Disabled safety stub. Direct Hermes bytecode modification is not enabled.
